title: Technical Engineering Manager - Salesforce
jobDescription:
Job Description: Salesforce Engineering Manager

We are seeking a Salesforce Engineering Manager to lead distributed engineering teams and drive delivery of complex projects across Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud. This role requires strong leadership, technical depth in Salesforce implementations, and the ability to align cross‑functional teams to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions. Engineering Manager Responsibilities include researching and developing new products, building projects and overseeing the successful execution of projects throughout the year. Ultimately, you will work closely with different teams to ensure projects are completed according to schedule and budget.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, build, and manage globally distributed Salesforce engineering teams.

  • Plan and execute long‑term strategies for Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud implementations.

  • Understand and improve engineering KPIs, with a focus on Salesforce platform performance and scalability.

  • Lead and drive significant results across multiple teams, including:

    • Managing 3+ engineers with direct reports.

    • Overseeing 2+ Salesforce engineering teams focused on CPQ/Billing solutions.

    • Leading business‑critical cross‑functional initiatives involving Sales, Finance, and Product.

  • Conduct managerial interviews and mentor engineering managers in Salesforce hiring practices.

  • Generate and implement process improvements for Salesforce development, testing, and release management.

  • Hold regular 1:1s and skip‑level meetings to foster growth and alignment.

  • Provide management mentorship and career planning guidance.

  • Enable collaboration across Product, Quality, UX, and Finance teams to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business needs.

  • Drive psychological safety and inclusivity across Salesforce engineering teams.

  • Draft quarterly OKRs and Salesforce‑specific KPIs (e.g., CPQ quote accuracy, Billing automation efficiency).

  • Improve product quality, security, and performance within Salesforce implementations.

  • Identify training needs and talent development opportunities in Salesforce CPQ/Billing.

  • Lead R&D projects to explore new Salesforce features and integrations.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Finance stakeholders to design scalable quoting, billing, and revenue recognition processes.

  • Propose budgets and resource plans for Salesforce programs.

  • Create reports and dashboards to provide project updates.

  • Attend Salesforce workshops, conferences, and training sessions.

  • Train new employees on Salesforce onboarding and development practices.

  • Support personal growth of team members, aligning ambitions with organizational Salesforce goals.

  • Generate Salesforce roadmaps and provide long‑term vision for CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud adoption.

Requirements and Skills

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager or Salesforce leader managing distributed teams.

  • Hands‑on expertise in Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud.

  • Strong analytical skills for evaluating Salesforce data and solving complex implementation challenges.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross‑functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, and Product teams.

  • Detail‑oriented with ability to identify critical Salesforce issues impacting revenue processes.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong problem‑solving abilities in Salesforce architecture and integrations.

  • Ability to collaborate with geographically dispersed teams.

  • Interpersonal skills to navigate challenging Salesforce implementations and deliver customer‑ready solutions.

  • Experience hiring, coaching, and mentoring Salesforce engineers and managers.

  • Ability to make effective, timely decisions in fast‑paced Salesforce project environments.

  • Interpersonal skills to successfully navigate challenging situations and effectively deliver products to end customers

  • Ability to hire, coach, and mentor engineers and fellow managers on a continuous basis


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Trimble’s Privacy Policy

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact Ask PX@px.trimble.com.

Job Description: Salesforce Engineering Manager We are seeking a Salesforce Engineering Manager to lead distributed engineering teams and drive delivery of complex projects across Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud. This role requires strong leadership, technical depth in Salesforce implementations, and the ability to align cross‑functional teams to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions. Engineering Manager Responsibilities include researching and developing new products, building projects and overseeing the successful execution of projects throughout the year Ultimately, you will work closely with different teams to ensure projects are completed according to schedule and budget. Responsibilities Hire, build, and manage globally distributed Salesforce engineering teams. Plan and execute long‑term strategies for Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud implementations. Understand and improve engineering KPIs, with a focus on Salesforce platform performance and scalability. Lead and drive significant results across multiple teams, including: Managing 3+ engineers with direct reports. Overseeing 2+ Salesforce engineering teams focused on CPQ/Billing solutions. Leading business‑critical cross‑functional initiatives involving Sales, Finance, and Product. Conduct managerial interviews and mentor engineering managers in Salesforce hiring practices. Generate and implement process improvements for Salesforce development, testing, and release management. Hold regular 1:1s and skip‑level meetings to foster growth and alignment. Provide management mentorship and career planning guidance. Enable collaboration across Product, Quality, UX, and Finance teams to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business needs. Drive psychological safety and inclusivity across Salesforce engineering teams. Draft quarterly OKRs and Salesforce‑specific KPIs (e.g., CPQ quote accuracy, Billing automation efficiency). Improve product quality, security, and performance within Salesforce implementations. Identify training needs and talent development opportunities in Salesforce CPQ/Billing. Lead R&D projects to explore new Salesforce features and integrations. Collaborate with Sales and Finance stakeholders to design scalable quoting, billing, and revenue recognition processes. Propose budgets and resource plans for Salesforce programs. Create reports and dashboards to provide project updates. Attend Salesforce workshops, conferences, and training sessions. Train new employees on Salesforce onboarding and development practices. Support personal growth of team members, aligning ambitions with organizational Salesforce goals. Generate Salesforce roadmaps and provide long‑term vision for CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud adoption. Requirements and Skills Proven experience as an Engineering Manager or Salesforce leader managing distributed teams. Hands‑on expertise in Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud . Strong analytical skills for evaluating Salesforce data and solving complex implementation challenges. Excellent communication skills for cross‑functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, and Product teams. Detail‑oriented with ability to identify critical Salesforce issues impacting revenue processes. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Strong problem‑solving abilities in Salesforce architecture and integrations. Ability to collaborate with geographically dispersed teams. Interpersonal skills to navigate challenging Salesforce implementations and deliver customer‑ready solutions. Experience hiring, coaching, and mentoring Salesforce engineers and managers. Ability to make effective, timely decisions in fast‑paced Salesforce project environments. Interpersonal skills to successfully navigate challenging situations and effectively deliver products to end customers Ability to hire, coach, and mentor engineers and fellow managers on a continuous basis How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the 'Apply Now' button located in this posting. Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate. At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words-they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter. Trimble's Privacy Policy If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact Ask PX@px.trimble.com. Job Description: Salesforce Engineering Manager

We are seeking a Salesforce Engineering Manager to lead distributed engineering teams and drive delivery of complex projects across Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud. This role requires strong leadership, technical depth in Salesforce implementations, and the ability to align cross‑functional teams to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions. Engineering Manager Responsibilities include researching and developing new products, building projects and overseeing the successful execution of projects throughout the year. Ultimately, you will work closely with different teams to ensure projects are completed according to schedule and budget.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, build, and manage globally distributed Salesforce engineering teams.

  • Plan and execute long‑term strategies for Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud implementations.

  • Understand and improve engineering KPIs, with a focus on Salesforce platform performance and scalability.

  • Lead and drive significant results across multiple teams, including:

    • Managing 3+ engineers with direct reports.

    • Overseeing 2+ Salesforce engineering teams focused on CPQ/Billing solutions.

    • Leading business‑critical cross‑functional initiatives involving Sales, Finance, and Product.

  • Conduct managerial interviews and mentor engineering managers in Salesforce hiring practices.

  • Generate and implement process improvements for Salesforce development, testing, and release management.

  • Hold regular 1:1s and skip‑level meetings to foster growth and alignment.

  • Provide management mentorship and career planning guidance.

  • Enable collaboration across Product, Quality, UX, and Finance teams to ensure Salesforce solutions meet business needs.

  • Drive psychological safety and inclusivity across Salesforce engineering teams.

  • Draft quarterly OKRs and Salesforce‑specific KPIs (e.g., CPQ quote accuracy, Billing automation efficiency).

  • Improve product quality, security, and performance within Salesforce implementations.

  • Identify training needs and talent development opportunities in Salesforce CPQ/Billing.

  • Lead R&D projects to explore new Salesforce features and integrations.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Finance stakeholders to design scalable quoting, billing, and revenue recognition processes.

  • Propose budgets and resource plans for Salesforce programs.

  • Create reports and dashboards to provide project updates.

  • Attend Salesforce workshops, conferences, and training sessions.

  • Train new employees on Salesforce onboarding and development practices.

  • Support personal growth of team members, aligning ambitions with organizational Salesforce goals.

  • Generate Salesforce roadmaps and provide long‑term vision for CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud adoption.

Requirements and Skills

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager or Salesforce leader managing distributed teams.

  • Hands‑on expertise in Salesforce CPQ, Billing, and Revenue Cloud.

  • Strong analytical skills for evaluating Salesforce data and solving complex implementation challenges.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross‑functional collaboration with Sales, Finance, and Product teams.

  • Detail‑oriented with ability to identify critical Salesforce issues impacting revenue processes.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong problem‑solving abilities in Salesforce architecture and integrations.

  • Ability to collaborate with geographically dispersed teams.

  • Interpersonal skills to navigate challenging Salesforce implementations and deliver customer‑ready solutions.

  • Experience hiring, coaching, and mentoring Salesforce engineers and managers.

  • Ability to make effective, timely decisions in fast‑paced Salesforce project environments.

  • Interpersonal skills to successfully navigate challenging situations and effectively deliver products to end customers

  • Ability to hire, coach, and mentor engineers and fellow managers on a continuous basis


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Trimble’s Privacy Policy

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact Ask PX@px.trimble.com.

title: Staff software Engineer - Snowflake/AI Automation Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Snowflake / AI Automation Engineer to support Revenue AI–driven automation initiatives across enterprise financial and revenue systems. This role will focus on designing, developing, and optimizing data pipelines, analytics, and automation solutions on Snowflake, with deep integration into ERP and revenue accounting platforms. The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of Snowflake expertise including Cortex Analyst, Snowflake Intelligence etc.., ERP systems knowledge, and automation/AI enablement experience to support scalable, compliant, and audit-ready revenue processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize Snowflake-based data models and pipelines to support Revenue AI and automation use cases

  • Develop scalable solutions to automate revenue recognition, forecasting, analytics, and reporting

  • Integrate Snowflake with ERP systems like Salesforce and Oracle to enable end-to-end Quote-to-Revenue (Q2R) workflows

  • Support AI/ML-enabled analytics by preparing high-quality, governed datasets for advanced modeling and automation

  • Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Accounting, IT, and Data Science teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions

  • Ensure data accuracy, reconciliation, and compliance with SOX and audit requirements

  • Optimize Snowflake performance, cost management, and security best practices

  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and production support related to revenue systems and automation

  • Contribute to documentation, controls, and operational runbooks for enterprise data platforms

Required Qualifications

    • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, including:

      • Data modeling

      • Cortex Analyst, Search

      • Snowflake Intelligence

      • Performance optimization

      • Security and access controls

      • Data sharing and automation

      • Security and access controls


    • Strong ERP experience, preferably with:

      • Oracle EBS / Oracle Cloud ERP

      • SAP

      • Net Suite

    • Experience supporting Revenue, Finance, or Accounting domains, especially Rev Pro or other revenue accounting platforms is preferred.

    • Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python preferred)

    • Experience building automated data pipelines using modern ELT/ETL tools

    • Strong understanding of data governance, controls, and audit readiness

    • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders

    • Experience with AI/ML analytics, predictive modeling

    • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

    • Knowledge of modern data tools (dbt, Airflow, CI/CD for data platforms)


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Snowflake / AI Automation Engineer to support Revenue AI-driven automation initiatives across enterprise financial and revenue systems. This role will focus on designing, developing, and optimizing data pipelines, analytics, and automation solutions on Snowflake , with deep integration into ERP and revenue accounting platforms. The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of Snowflake expertise including Cortex Analyst, Snowflake Intelligence etc.., ERP systems knowledge, and automation/AI enablement experience to support scalable, compliant, and audit-ready revenue processes. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and optimize Snowflake-based data models and pipelines to support Revenue AI and automation use cases Develop scalable solutions to automate revenue recognition, forecasting, analytics, and reporting Integrate Snowflake with ERP systems like Salesforce and Oracle to enable end-to-end Quote-to-Revenue (Q2R) workflows Support AI/ML-enabled analytics by preparing high-quality, governed datasets for advanced modeling and automation Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Accounting, IT, and Data Science teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions Ensure data accuracy, reconciliation, and compliance with SOX and audit requirements Optimize Snowflake performance, cost management, and security best practices Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and production support related to revenue systems and automation Contribute to documentation, controls, and operational runbooks for enterprise data platforms Required Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake , including: Data modeling Cortex Analyst, Search Snowflake Intelligence Performance optimization Security and access controls Data sharing and automation Security and access controls Strong ERP experience , preferably with: Oracle EBS / Oracle Cloud ERP SAP Net Suite Experience supporting Revenue, Finance, or Accounting domains, especially Rev Pro or other revenue accounting platforms is preferred. Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python preferred) Experience building automated data pipelines using modern ELT/ETL tools Strong understanding of data governance, controls, and audit readiness Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience with AI/ML analytics, predictive modeling Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Knowledge of modern data tools (dbt, Airflow, CI/CD for data platforms) How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the 'Apply Now' button located in this posting. Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate. At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words-they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter. Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Snowflake / AI Automation Engineer to support Revenue AI–driven automation initiatives across enterprise financial and revenue systems. This role will focus on designing, developing, and optimizing data pipelines, analytics, and automation solutions on Snowflake, with deep integration into ERP and revenue accounting platforms. The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of Snowflake expertise including Cortex Analyst, Snowflake Intelligence etc.., ERP systems knowledge, and automation/AI enablement experience to support scalable, compliant, and audit-ready revenue processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize Snowflake-based data models and pipelines to support Revenue AI and automation use cases

  • Develop scalable solutions to automate revenue recognition, forecasting, analytics, and reporting

  • Integrate Snowflake with ERP systems like Salesforce and Oracle to enable end-to-end Quote-to-Revenue (Q2R) workflows

  • Support AI/ML-enabled analytics by preparing high-quality, governed datasets for advanced modeling and automation

  • Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Accounting, IT, and Data Science teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions

  • Ensure data accuracy, reconciliation, and compliance with SOX and audit requirements

  • Optimize Snowflake performance, cost management, and security best practices

  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and production support related to revenue systems and automation

  • Contribute to documentation, controls, and operational runbooks for enterprise data platforms

Required Qualifications

    • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, including:

      • Data modeling

      • Cortex Analyst, Search

      • Snowflake Intelligence

      • Performance optimization

      • Security and access controls

      • Data sharing and automation

      • Security and access controls


    • Strong ERP experience, preferably with:

      • Oracle EBS / Oracle Cloud ERP

      • SAP

      • Net Suite

    • Experience supporting Revenue, Finance, or Accounting domains, especially Rev Pro or other revenue accounting platforms is preferred.

    • Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python preferred)

    • Experience building automated data pipelines using modern ELT/ETL tools

    • Strong understanding of data governance, controls, and audit readiness

    • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders

    • Experience with AI/ML analytics, predictive modeling

    • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

    • Knowledge of modern data tools (dbt, Airflow, CI/CD for data platforms)


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

title: Market Development Manager MEP
jobDescription:
Lead the Next Wave of Construction Tech as a Market Development Manager - MEP (Stabicad)

Are you an entrepreneurial market builder ready to launch and scale a global leading software in an untapped, greenfield territory? Trimble is looking for a strategic business leader to roll out the "India MEP Strategy" for Stabicad—our premier MEP design and detailing software that runs natively on Autodesk Revit. If you are comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving technical strategy, and treating a territory like your own business, this is your chance to build a foundation for long-term market dominance.

About Us:

Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com

Our Portfolio & The Opportunity: While Trimble has an incredibly strong, established footprint in India with our structural portfolio (Tekla), the Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) sector represents a massive, untapped opportunity. Stabicad enables MEP modelers to create constructible 3D models with unmatched productivity, and you will lead the charge in establishing its footprint.

What Makes This Role Great:

In this role, you will be the absolute business leader for the Indian MEP territory, serving as the strategic bridge between global product teams and local market needs. You will partner with a dedicated technical Sales Engineer to validate product-market fit, map the "Right to Win," and secure the initial wave of high-profile customer references. Operating at a high level of executive visibility, your impact will be immediate and measurable as you transform top-tier firms into "raving fans" of our ecosystem.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Own the Success of Stabicad in India: Act as the primary business owner for the product line, driving product feedback, market-fit validation, commercial sales, and localized country strategy to support long-term revenue goals.

  • Market Strategy & Product Intelligence: Serve as the "eyes and ears" in the field. Sharpen sector deep-dives across MEP consultancies, BIM chapters, and general contractors, delivering direct feedback to global Product Management regarding essential local standards and content libraries.

  • Strategic Business Development: Hunt and secure net-new, MEP-focused accounts. Move conversations with C-level executives and directors at tier-1 firms from basic features to core business outcomes (pre-fabrication, risk reduction, and detailing efficiency).

  • Ecosystem & Partnership Architecture: Identify, align, and partner with key Indian industry organizations, BIM institutions, and manufacturing bodies to position Stabicad as the definitive market thought leader.

  • Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Guide the everyday focus of your technical Sales Engineer to align demos with strategic value, while collaborating with the Tekla sales team to unlock cross-sell opportunities within large general contractors.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of professional experience within the Construction/MEP industry or the Construction Tech software marketplace in India.

  • Revit & BIM Ecosystem Fluency: Strong fundamental understanding of the Autodesk Revit ecosystem; you must clearly understand the operational differences between design, detailing, and fabrication workflows.

  • Strategic Hunter Mindset: A proven track record of successfully entering new regional markets or launching net-new products, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and build pipelines from scratch.

  • Core Competencies: Entrepreneurial drive to treat the territory like a private business, proactive problem-solving, and the technical savvy to translate localized industry needs into formal product business cases.

Bonus Points For:

  • Established professional connections or prior experience working alongside relevant Indian industry associations and consulting bodies.

  • An active, robust network of C-level and director-level contacts within the Indian MEP and construction contractor ecosystem.

Logistics:

  • Location: Navi Mumbai, India

  • Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.

  • Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.

  • Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

  • Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Field Systems Finance DX Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Description: Finance Digital Transformation Lead (The "Enabler")

Role Overview: As the Lead for the Digital Transformation Pod, you are the architect of the future. You will not be "doing" the monthly close; you will be automating it. Your mission is to build the AI-driven systems that generate our "Zero-Draft" forecasts and empower our Controllers with real-time strategic insights.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES: -

  • Architect the "Zero-Draft": Design and maintain the AI agents that produce baseline revenue, Opex, and OCOGS forecasts for all 8 business units.
  • Unified Data Schema Management: Partner with the VP of Finance to enforce a single, global data standard across the Field Systems portfolio.
  • Self-Service Tool Building: Develop and tune the "What-If" simulation dashboards used by Embedded Controllers during Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs).
  • Process Engineering: Identify manual "friction points" in the FP&A Hub (e.g., headcount syncing or freight tracking) and build automated solutions to eliminate them.
  • AI Tuning & Governance: Continuously refine the logic and prompts used by our financial agents to improve forecast accuracy month-over-month.

Required Experience: -

  • 5-8 years of experience in a hybrid role (Fin Tech, Business Intelligence, or Advanced FP&A).
  • Proven track record of moving an organization from manual Excel-based reporting to automated, data-lake-driven analytics.
  • Deep experience with SQL and at least one scripting language (Python/R).
  • The "Finance Filter": You must be able to explain a complex data architecture to a Division GM and a complex revenue recognition rule to a software engineer.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: -

  • Experience in a manufacturing or Saa S environment (understanding both hardware and recurring revenue models).
  • Exposure to AI/ML implementation within a corporate finance setting.

title: Technical Customer Support Professional
jobDescription:
Empower Structural Innovation as a Technical Support Professional – Tekla Structures (Concrete, Precast, & Rebar)

Are you a customer-focused structural professional who loves deconstructing complex software challenges? Trimble is seeking a high-caliber Technical Support Professional to join our dedicated Customer Support network. In this high-impact position, you will serve as the premier point of contact for enterprise clients navigating advanced workflows within Tekla Structures, specifically focusing on the Concrete, Precast, and Rebar modules. Your immediate technical expertise will ensure engineering and detailing teams around the world minimize downtime and achieve structural precision.

About Us:

Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com

Our Product Ecosystem: Tekla software solutions are the global standard for advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structural engineering. From massive cast-in-place concrete structures to complex precast components and high-density reinforcement detailing, Tekla drives structural lifecycle efficiency from design to the job site.

What Makes This Role Great:

In this role, you will transition from a day-to-day detailer or modeller into a highly valued structural subject matter expert. Operating within our state-of-the-art hubs in Chennai or Navi Mumbai, you will have the technical autonomy to reverse-engineer software anomalies, troubleshoot localized configurations, and configure cross-platform cloud integrations. You will work closely with global helpdesks and act as a crucial voice-of-the-customer, directly collaborating with Trimble’s Product Development teams to advocate for product updates and eliminate architectural bottlenecks.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Complex Modeling Resolution: Provide clear, step-by-step technical guidance to resolve advanced structural modeling and parametric geometry issues faced by global engineering accounts.

  • Database & Catalog Orchestration: Manage, audit, and troubleshoot intricate software databases, custom reinforcement catalogs, and automated Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).

  • Deliverable Configuration Support: Assist detailers in configuring and optimizing General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Cast Unit drawings, automated rebar schedules, and custom Template Editor (.tpl) reports.

  • Environment Architecture Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve localized company environment bugs, including custom parametric components, complex drawing layouts, custom attributes, and enterprise firm/project folder paths.

  • Cloud & Interoperability Engineering: Support collaborative cloud workspaces by resolving interoperability bottlenecks across Trimble Connect, Tekla Model Sharing, and open BIM data exchanges (IFC, DWG, DXF, BVBS).

  • Bug Replication & Product Escalation: Systematically replicate user-reported software errors, document system limitations, and escalate unresolved code defects to global development teams while populating internal knowledge bases.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Professional Experience: 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience utilizing or supporting Tekla Structures. Highly preferred experience operating within an RCC, Precast detailing, or high-fidelity BIM production environment.

  • Technical Deep-Dive Mastery: Complete mastery of Tekla Structures software functionality, system configurations, directory folders, detailing standards, and reinforcement modules.

  • Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with a proven capability to investigate system logs, reverse-engineer software errors, and troubleshoot severe system crashes under pressure.

  • Communication & Deadline Focus: Exceptional, patient, and highly professional written and verbal communication skills to deliver technical solutions clearly to users working under strict engineering deadlines.

  • EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.

Bonus Points For:

  • Workflow Automation Tooling: Practical knowledge or script exposure to Tekla Open API, C#, or Grasshopper for parametric workflow automation.

  • Advanced Component Customization: Direct experience developing complex parametric Custom Components and custom software macros.

  • Cross-Domain Competency: Prior structural background or foundational workflow knowledge in structural steel detailing and fabrication logic.

Logistics:

  • Locations: Chennai or Navi Mumbai, India

  • Department: Customer Support / Technical Services

  • Job Type: Full-Time

description:
Empower Structural Innovation as a Technical Support Professional – Tekla Structures (Concrete, Precast, & Rebar)

Are you a customer-focused structural professional who loves deconstructing complex software challenges? Trimble is seeking a high-caliber Technical Support Professional to join our dedicated Customer Support network. In this high-impact position, you will serve as the premier point of contact for enterprise clients navigating advanced workflows within Tekla Structures, specifically focusing on the Concrete, Precast, and Rebar modules. Your immediate technical expertise will ensure engineering and detailing teams around the world minimize downtime and achieve structural precision.

About Us:

Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com

Our Product Ecosystem: Tekla software solutions are the global standard for advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structural engineering. From massive cast-in-place concrete structures to complex precast components and high-density reinforcement detailing, Tekla drives structural lifecycle efficiency from design to the job site.

What Makes This Role Great:

In this role, you will transition from a day-to-day detailer or modeller into a highly valued structural subject matter expert. Operating within our state-of-the-art hubs in Chennai or Navi Mumbai, you will have the technical autonomy to reverse-engineer software anomalies, troubleshoot localized configurations, and configure cross-platform cloud integrations. You will work closely with global helpdesks and act as a crucial voice-of-the-customer, directly collaborating with Trimble’s Product Development teams to advocate for product updates and eliminate architectural bottlenecks.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Complex Modeling Resolution: Provide clear, step-by-step technical guidance to resolve advanced structural modeling and parametric geometry issues faced by global engineering accounts.

  • Database & Catalog Orchestration: Manage, audit, and troubleshoot intricate software databases, custom reinforcement catalogs, and automated Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).

  • Deliverable Configuration Support: Assist detailers in configuring and optimizing General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Cast Unit drawings, automated rebar schedules, and custom Template Editor (.tpl) reports.

  • Environment Architecture Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve localized company environment bugs, including custom parametric components, complex drawing layouts, custom attributes, and enterprise firm/project folder paths.

  • Cloud & Interoperability Engineering: Support collaborative cloud workspaces by resolving interoperability bottlenecks across Trimble Connect, Tekla Model Sharing, and open BIM data exchanges (IFC, DWG, DXF, BVBS).

  • Bug Replication & Product Escalation: Systematically replicate user-reported software errors, document system limitations, and escalate unresolved code defects to global development teams while populating internal knowledge bases.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Professional Experience: 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience utilizing or supporting Tekla Structures. Highly preferred experience operating within an RCC, Precast detailing, or high-fidelity BIM production environment.

  • Technical Deep-Dive Mastery: Complete mastery of Tekla Structures software functionality, system configurations, directory folders, detailing standards, and reinforcement modules.

  • Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with a proven capability to investigate system logs, reverse-engineer software errors, and troubleshoot severe system crashes under pressure.

  • Communication & Deadline Focus: Exceptional, patient, and highly professional written and verbal communication skills to deliver technical solutions clearly to users working under strict engineering deadlines.

  • EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.

Bonus Points For:

  • Workflow Automation Tooling: Practical knowledge or script exposure to Tekla Open API, C#, or Grasshopper for parametric workflow automation.

  • Advanced Component Customization: Direct experience developing complex parametric Custom Components and custom software macros.

  • Cross-Domain Competency: Prior structural background or foundational workflow knowledge in structural steel detailing and fabrication logic.

Logistics:

  • Locations: Chennai or Navi Mumbai, India

  • Department: Customer Support / Technical Services

  • Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.

  • Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.

  • Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

  • Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

title: License Compliance Specialist
jobDescription:
Protect Intellectual Property and Drive Revenue Integrity as a License Compliance Specialist

Are you a strategic sales or compliance professional who excels at navigating high-stakes negotiations and turning challenging situations into positive commercial outcomes? The Trimble License Compliance program ensures our customers maximize productivity, mitigate operational risks, and receive the full value from their software investment. As part of our Global License Compliance initiative, you will work closely with authorized collaborators, distribution networks, and legal teams across the India & SAARC region to protect Trimble's intellectual property while fostering legitimate market growth.

About Us:

Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com.
Our Program Ecosystem: By protecting our Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) and securing legitimate businesses, the Global License Compliance program safeguards the revenue that directly funds Trimble's continuous product development and industry-leading technology innovations.

What Makes This Role Great:

In this highly impactful position, You will manage complex, multi-stakeholder scenarios, bridging the gap between legal enforcement and consultative software sales. Armed with state-of-the-art telemetry tools like Cylynt, you will have the autonomy to guide external compliance agencies, orchestrate high-stakes C-level negotiations, and uncover up-selling opportunities—all while maintaining an impeccable corporate brand image and driving long-term customer health.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Agency & Ecosystem Management: Build and manage partnerships with appointed compliance agencies, advising them on adequate licensing settlements and ensuring smooth market operations.
  • Telemetry Data & Lead Analysis: Review, validate, and analyze software piracy telemetry and compliance leads using specialized internal tools, databases, and dashboards.
  • Strategic Partner Negotiations: Lead C-level executive negotiations and complex legal escalations for large enterprise accounts, mitigating piracy pushback through an ecosystem-oriented, relation-preserving mindset.
  • Commercial Alignment & Growth: Collaborate with regional Sales teams and channel partners to turn compliance events into positive commercial outcomes (reconciliation purchases, up-selling, and minimizing renewal churn).
  • Pipeline Analysis & Reporting: Monitor and maintain highly accurate pipeline forecasting, tracking Quarter-to-Date (QTD) and Year-to-Date (YTD) performance metrics metrics inside enterprise CRM dashboards.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Professional Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional experience within a software License Compliance, IT Audit, or Piracy management environment.
  • Core Sales Mandate: Proven sales experience with a number-sensitive mindset and a referenceable track record of meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual targets.
  • Specialized Telemetry Tooling: Direct, hands-on experience utilizing Cylynt (formerly known as Smartflow) compliance tracking or telemetry software.
  • CRM Proficiency: Practical operational experience with Salesforce CRM for pipeline management, tracking, and reporting.
  • Negotiation Mastery: Proven experience successfully leading multi-stakeholder C-level corporate negotiations or structured legal escalations.
  • EDUCATION: Bachelor's degree in Law, Business, Information Technology, or a closely related professional discipline.
  • Core Competencies: Fluent English communication skills, high analytical capability to interpret data scenarios, process-oriented mindset, and absolute commitment to data confidentiality, work ethics, and integrity.


Bonus Points For:

  • Direct experience managing compliance operations within the AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations) software sectors in India.
  • Proven experience establishing and deploying new compliance processes or procedures that significantly increase regional operational efficiency.
  • Strong structural understanding of international software end-user license agreements (EULAs) and corporate copyright frameworks.


Logistics:

  • Locations: Mumbai / Gurugram, India
  • Travel Requirement: Open to regional travel across India and the SAARC geography as required for audits, partner alignment, or on-site client negotiations.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
  • Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
  • Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
  • Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant.


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

description:
Protect Intellectual Property and Drive Revenue Integrity as a License Compliance Specialist

Are you a strategic sales or compliance professional who excels at navigating high-stakes negotiations and turning challenging situations into positive commercial outcomes? The Trimble License Compliance program ensures our customers maximize productivity, mitigate operational risks, and receive the full value from their software investment. As part of our Global License Compliance initiative, you will work closely with authorized collaborators, distribution networks, and legal teams across the India & SAARC region to protect Trimble's intellectual property while fostering legitimate market growth.

About Us:

Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com.
Our Program Ecosystem: By protecting our Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) and securing legitimate businesses, the Global License Compliance program safeguards the revenue that directly funds Trimble's continuous product development and industry-leading technology innovations.

What Makes This Role Great:

In this highly impactful position, You will manage complex, multi-stakeholder scenarios, bridging the gap between legal enforcement and consultative software sales. Armed with state-of-the-art telemetry tools like Cylynt, you will have the autonomy to guide external compliance agencies, orchestrate high-stakes C-level negotiations, and uncover up-selling opportunities—all while maintaining an impeccable corporate brand image and driving long-term customer health.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Agency & Ecosystem Management: Build and manage partnerships with appointed compliance agencies, advising them on adequate licensing settlements and ensuring smooth market operations.
  • Telemetry Data & Lead Analysis: Review, validate, and analyze software piracy telemetry and compliance leads using specialized internal tools, databases, and dashboards.
  • Strategic Partner Negotiations: Lead C-level executive negotiations and complex legal escalations for large enterprise accounts, mitigating piracy pushback through an ecosystem-oriented, relation-preserving mindset.
  • Commercial Alignment & Growth: Collaborate with regional Sales teams and channel partners to turn compliance events into positive commercial outcomes (reconciliation purchases, up-selling, and minimizing renewal churn).
  • Pipeline Analysis & Reporting: Monitor and maintain highly accurate pipeline forecasting, tracking Quarter-to-Date (QTD) and Year-to-Date (YTD) performance metrics metrics inside enterprise CRM dashboards.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Professional Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional experience within a software License Compliance, IT Audit, or Piracy management environment.
  • Core Sales Mandate: Proven sales experience with a number-sensitive mindset and a referenceable track record of meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual targets.
  • Specialized Telemetry Tooling: Direct, hands-on experience utilizing Cylynt (formerly known as Smartflow) compliance tracking or telemetry software.
  • CRM Proficiency: Practical operational experience with Salesforce CRM for pipeline management, tracking, and reporting.
  • Negotiation Mastery: Proven experience successfully leading multi-stakeholder C-level corporate negotiations or structured legal escalations.
  • EDUCATION: Bachelor's degree in Law, Business, Information Technology, or a closely related professional discipline.
  • Core Competencies: Fluent English communication skills, high analytical capability to interpret data scenarios, process-oriented mindset, and absolute commitment to data confidentiality, work ethics, and integrity.


Bonus Points For:

  • Direct experience managing compliance operations within the AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations) software sectors in India.
  • Proven experience establishing and deploying new compliance processes or procedures that significantly increase regional operational efficiency.
  • Strong structural understanding of international software end-user license agreements (EULAs) and corporate copyright frameworks.


Logistics:

  • Locations: Mumbai / Gurugram, India
  • Travel Requirement: Open to regional travel across India and the SAARC geography as required for audits, partner alignment, or on-site client negotiations.
  • Job Type: Full-Time


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
  • Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
  • Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
  • Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant.


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

title: Regional Marketing Manager, India (AECO)
jobDescription:
About the Role

As Trimble expands its APAC marketing team, we are seeking a highly accountable Regional Marketing Manager to lead our AECO marketing strategy in India. Serving as the country-level leader, you will own and execute a full-funnel demand generation and field marketing strategy across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments to drive targeted pipeline and revenue growth.

As the India team lead, you will manage local priorities, mentor team members, and align seamlessly with cross-functional partners like Sales, SDRs, Presales and other regional functions. Ultimately, you will represent India's market needs in regional APAC planning, ensuring your initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes to pipeline and bookings, local customer expansion, and lasting brand strength.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Planning: Own the annual India marketing goals, strategy and plan, aligned with regional objectives and global marketing KPIs.
  • Demand Generation & Pipeline Growth: Lead India’s full-funnel demand generation programs that directly contribute to pipeline and revenue goals, while closely partnering with local Sales, SDRs, technical teams, ultimately driving new business opportunities and growing existing business.
  • Budget Management & ROI: Own and manage the India marketing budget, rigorously measuring impact on sourced pipeline and bookings, and regularly report on marketing effectiveness and ROI to local stakeholders as well as roll-ups to APAC and Global metrics.
  • Campaign Management: Successfully execute multi-channel demand generation programs (paid, earned and owned media, events, webinars, etc.) and highly targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategies. Closely collaborate with global and regional marketing teams to adapt campaigns for local relevance.
  • Field Marketing & Events: Design and execute a localized events strategy, including executive roundtables, tradeshows, and Trimble-hosted events, to build pipeline, brand awareness and thought leadership.
  • Digital & Performance Marketing: Implement and report on performance marketing across digital platforms that work best in India like Linked In, PPC, software review sites and any other platforms best suited to India, collaborating with a global paid media team to drive high-intent opportunities.
  • Strategic Local Partnerships: Own and drive relations and initiatives with key local industry bodies, associations, advisories, and technology alliances to expand market reach.
  • People Management: Mentor and coach a high-performing, data-driven marketing team while managing external agencies and contractors
  • Content & Localization: Create and manage India-specific content and messaging that resonates with local audiences while ensuring alignment with Trimble’s global brand story.
  • PR & Awareness: Work with internal stakeholders and external agencies to increase Trimble’s share of voice and brand recognition in India.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: Minimum 12 years of B2B marketing experience in India, ideally within high-growth Saa S or technology organizations (CAD/CAM/BIM industry or construction technology experience would be a big plus!)
  • Leadership skills: Minimum 4 years of strong leadership skills with proven experience managing and developing a team
  • Domain Expertise: Data-backed, proven track record in demand generation, field marketing, digital marketing, event management, and integrated campaigns.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency with Marketing Automation Tools (MAT), CRM (e.g., Salesforce), and analytics tools.
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent ability to build relationships and align priorities across sales, product marketing, and regional/global teams within a matrixed organization.
  • Industry Knowledge: Knowledge of the construction & infrastructure industries and an understanding of their unique personas is highly preferred.
  • Analytical Skills: Metrics-driven mindset with the ability to define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs).


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

description:
About the Role

As Trimble expands its APAC marketing team, we are seeking a highly accountable Regional Marketing Manager to lead our AECO marketing strategy in India. Serving as the country-level leader, you will own and execute a full-funnel demand generation and field marketing strategy across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments to drive targeted pipeline and revenue growth.

As the India team lead, you will manage local priorities, mentor team members, and align seamlessly with cross-functional partners like Sales, SDRs, Presales and other regional functions. Ultimately, you will represent India's market needs in regional APAC planning, ensuring your initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes to pipeline and bookings, local customer expansion, and lasting brand strength.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Planning: Own the annual India marketing goals, strategy and plan, aligned with regional objectives and global marketing KPIs.
  • Demand Generation & Pipeline Growth: Lead India’s full-funnel demand generation programs that directly contribute to pipeline and revenue goals, while closely partnering with local Sales, SDRs, technical teams, ultimately driving new business opportunities and growing existing business.
  • Budget Management & ROI: Own and manage the India marketing budget, rigorously measuring impact on sourced pipeline and bookings, and regularly report on marketing effectiveness and ROI to local stakeholders as well as roll-ups to APAC and Global metrics.
  • Campaign Management: Successfully execute multi-channel demand generation programs (paid, earned and owned media, events, webinars, etc.) and highly targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategies. Closely collaborate with global and regional marketing teams to adapt campaigns for local relevance.
  • Field Marketing & Events: Design and execute a localized events strategy, including executive roundtables, tradeshows, and Trimble-hosted events, to build pipeline, brand awareness and thought leadership.
  • Digital & Performance Marketing: Implement and report on performance marketing across digital platforms that work best in India like Linked In, PPC, software review sites and any other platforms best suited to India, collaborating with a global paid media team to drive high-intent opportunities.
  • Strategic Local Partnerships: Own and drive relations and initiatives with key local industry bodies, associations, advisories, and technology alliances to expand market reach.
  • People Management: Mentor and coach a high-performing, data-driven marketing team while managing external agencies and contractors
  • Content & Localization: Create and manage India-specific content and messaging that resonates with local audiences while ensuring alignment with Trimble’s global brand story.
  • PR & Awareness: Work with internal stakeholders and external agencies to increase Trimble’s share of voice and brand recognition in India.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: Minimum 12 years of B2B marketing experience in India, ideally within high-growth Saa S or technology organizations (CAD/CAM/BIM industry or construction technology experience would be a big plus!)
  • Leadership skills: Minimum 4 years of strong leadership skills with proven experience managing and developing a team
  • Domain Expertise: Data-backed, proven track record in demand generation, field marketing, digital marketing, event management, and integrated campaigns.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency with Marketing Automation Tools (MAT), CRM (e.g., Salesforce), and analytics tools.
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent ability to build relationships and align priorities across sales, product marketing, and regional/global teams within a matrixed organization.
  • Industry Knowledge: Knowledge of the construction & infrastructure industries and an understanding of their unique personas is highly preferred.
  • Analytical Skills: Metrics-driven mindset with the ability to define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs).


How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobDescription:
Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Cloud & AI


Reporting to: Site Reliability Engineering Manager

Office Location: Chennai, India

Flexible Working: 4 Days per week @ Trimble Office location


Cloud Site Reliability Engineer Responsibilities

  • AIOps & Intelligent Automation: Lead the evaluation and implementation of AI/ML capabilities (like LLMs and predictive analytics) into the observability stack to enable automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing infrastructure
  • Observability & Open Telemetry: In-depth experience of Open Telemetry (OTel) in a large-scale organisation. Ability to lead and evangelise an ‘OTel First’ and Platform strategy in a global organisation.
  • Platform Management & Scalability: Maintain the entire observability platform that our customers rely on. This includes ensuring the observability platform is available and meeting our customers' needs included suggesting and implementing new capabilities
  • Performance & Cost Optimisation: Proactively monitor and optimise the platform's performance and efficiency to ensure the platform remains performant and economically viable as our observability grows.
  • Operational Excellence & Automation: Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools to streamline core SRE tasks, such as managing customer accounts, provisioning new data sources, and deploying updates. You'll use Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) tools like Terraform to ensure consistent and reproducible delivery. .
  • Feature Enablement & Support: Work closely with engineering teams to ensure new features are built with reliability and scalability in mind. You'll also provide technical expertise to assist the business in resolving complex issues and understanding platform capabilities.
  • Problem Management: you will input to problems that impact customer experience and thorough root cause analysis to prevent future incidents.
  • Observability Centre of Excellence: Play a key role in the Observability Centre of Excellence working closely with engineering teams to advise on best practices/standards for products/platforms to maximise/improve product availability, reliability, resiliency and security.
  • Availability Management: On-board internal customers to our 24x7 Applications Support and Enterprise Status Page services
  • Data Quality Management & Governance: Establish and enforce future capability of data quality standards across the observability pipeline. Optimising telemetry data pipelines, including data sanitisation, sampling strategies, and maintaining data schema consistency.



Skills & Experience

  • AI & AIOps Engineering: Hands-on experience embedding AI/ML into operational workflows. Familiarity with building LLM-backed agents and skills, utilising prompt engineering, or integrating AI agents into service operations.
  • Observability: Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and tracing tools such as New Relic (preferred), Datadog, Splunk.
  • Open Telemetry: Hands-on experience with the Open Telemetry framework, including the APIs, SDKs, and the Open Telemetry Collector would be beneficial.
  • SRE Frameworks & Methodologies: Deep understanding of core reliability monitoring frameworks, specifically Google’s Golden Signals, the RED method, and the USE method to design effective dashboarding and alerting strategies.
  • Coding and Scripting: Proficiency in at least one high-level language like Python, Go, or Java is crucial for building automation, tools, and monitoring scripts. Shell scripting (e.g., Bash) is also desired for system administration tasks. Experience with coding assistants like Co-Pilot
  • Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Skills in tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet are vital for automating the provisioning and management of infrastructure, ensuring consistency and repeatability.
  • Cloud Platforms: Solid expertise with a major cloud provider such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Azure is expected
  • Containerisation and Orchestration: A command of Docker for containerizing applications and Kubernetes for managing those containers at scale

No travel required



How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.
